policies.text: An enterprise achieves approved supplier qualification when its annual sales revenue equals 1500000 USD or more over the year, or when it holds a Tier-1 Supplier License.
Commercial clients receive extended payment terms when maintaining a safety compliance score above 85 points.
Placement on the top vendor registry is authorized for every firm that maintains approved supplier criteria.
A business secures fleet rate reductions if its fleet size equals at least 30 commercial vehicles.
A distributor qualifies for fast-track shipping if their warehouse capacity exceeds 10000 square meters.
